claims.text: Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Pulsed High-Power Microwave Source Technology", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-01-28 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-0912-005. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

edges.label: authored by
edges.note: The DIA congressional list credits 'Pulsed High-Power Microwave Technology' to 'Dr James Wells, J W Enterprises'. The earlier Knapp/KLAS-TV roster gives the same author with the affiliation Northrop Grumman; the DIA list governs. No verified biography for this author has been located beyond the list entry.

edges.label: series member
edges.note: Membership of the DIRD series is established by the released document itself: its cover page carries the Defense Intelligence Reference Document mark and the DIA Defense Futures banner. Publication date 28 January 2010 on the cover. 38 pages in the released copy. The cover of the scanned release is degraded, so a document number or date is asserted here only where it reads unambiguously.
